description: Create the GitHub Actions CI workflow at .github/workflows/p0c-e2e.yml that runs the P0-C Playwright specs against the live environment, captures artifacts, and produces a machine-readable JSON result mapping for all 41 test IDs.
steps: Create .github/workflows/p0c-e2e.yml with triggers: workflow_dispatch (manual) and push to feat/db-baseline-v1.1.5 branch.
Job setup: ubuntu-latest, Node 22, npm ci in frontend/, install Chromium via npx playwright install --with-deps chromium.

Environment variables from GitHub secrets: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, E2E_DESIGNER_EMAIL, E2E_DESIGNER_PASSWORD, E2E_CONSULTANT_EMAIL, E2E_CONSULTANT_PASSWORD, E2E_ADMIN_EMAIL, E2E_ADMIN_PASSWORD, PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL.
Add a connectivity check step that verifies reachability of both bom-beryl.vercel.app and fbiemsbykrmrbqcsobvh.supabase.co (curl with timeout, fail job early if unreachable).
Run Playwright: npx playwright test e2e/p0-c/ --reporter=html,json. Configure json reporter to output to test-results/p0c-results.json.

Add a post-test step that parses test-results/p0c-results.json and generates a machine-readable summary mapping all 41 test IDs to their results (PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED). Output as test-results/p0c-summary.json. Use a simple Node script inline or a small script file.
Upload artifacts: playwright-report/ (HTML report), test-results/ (traces, screenshots, videos, JSON results, summary). Use actions/upload-artifact@v4 with retention-days: 30.
Fail the job if any required P0-C test fails (default Playwright behavior - non-zero exit code).

Add a result classification step that maps Playwright outcomes to PASS/PARTIAL/BLOCKED/FAIL categories. PASS = test passed. FAIL = test failed with assertion error. BLOCKED = test failed due to network/setup error (timeout, connection refused). PARTIAL = test partially passed (some assertions ok, some failed).
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/p0c-e2e.yml is valid YAML and parseable by GitHub Actions
Workflow triggers on workflow_dispatch and push to feat/db-baseline-v1.1.5
All credentials come from GitHub secrets (never hardcoded)
Connectivity check verifies both target URLs
HTML report, traces, screenshots, videos uploaded as artifacts
Machine-readable JSON summary maps all 41 test IDs to results
Job fails if any test fails
verification: Run: python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/p0c-e2e.yml'))" or equivalent to validate YAML syntax

Grep the workflow for all required secrets: SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, E2E_DESIGNER_EMAIL, E2E_DESIGNER_PASSWORD, E2E_CONSULTANT_EMAIL, E2E_CONSULTANT_PASSWORD, E2E_ADMIN_EMAIL, E2E_ADMIN_PASSWORD, PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL
Confirm the workflow references 'npx playwright install' and 'npx playwright test e2e/p0-c/'
